evidence.note: Claim: tests/test_uc_surf_setup_ops_transcript.json and tests/test_uc_surf_loop_transcript.json are stale because the [slo] config section and its slo.target_review_finding_rate knob landed on main without re-recording the two CLI transcripts. Mechanism: the transcript pins capture every config section/key the CLI surfaces; a new section makes the recorded transcript stale. Falsifier: after running the recipe regen (DDFLOW_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 uv run pytest <transcript test>), ddflow pins regenerate --check would still report the pin stale. Probe: ran DDFLOW_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 uv run pytest tests/test_uc_surf_setup_ops_transcript.py -p no:xdist; check then reported setup-ops-transcript current and loop-transcript current. Verdict CONFIRMED.

Regenerated the two stale transcript pins in the item worktree via the recipe regen knob: DDFLOW_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 uv run pytest tests/test_uc_surf_setup_ops_transcript.py -p no:xdist -p no:cacheprovider (1 passed) and the same for test_uc_surf_loop_transcript.py (1 passed). Diff reviewed, not blindly accepted: setup-ops adds the [slo] section to its known-sections list and slo.target_review_finding_rate to the reviewer-knob table; loop-transcript adds slo.target_review_finding_rate to the review defaults line. Committed as 4ebecf497 'pins: regenerate setup-ops-transcript and loop-transcript'.

Governing rules and lessons applied: r-task-phase-needs-wave (task is in phase P-green-main, wave 0), r-gemini-key-load (no gemini review needed for a pin-regeneration; the diff is generated data, not code), D-small-files (no module touched). The changed files are regenerate-only pin data: never hand-edited.

evidence.note: Pin-only change (2 transcript JSON + 2 golden .ambr). No Python changed, so ruff/roborev standards tools have no code to check; the regenerated files are the output of the pinned generators themselves (pytest --snapshot-update / DDFLOW_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1), which are the standards for this class of file. Diff reviewed and legit: only new knobs/flags (slo section, perf_metrics.flaky_* knobs, ddflow wait --notify) surface changes.
